reason: Both correctly told the homeowner to stop resetting the RCD and escalate, but Conversation 1 delivered a complete, honest explanation in one turn - earth-leakage/insulation breakdown in a heating element as it warms, with a loose or burnt connection as a secondary possibility - plus a clear route to an electrician or Hotpoint engineer and no premature part recommendation; its only slip was saying 'unplugged' for a hardwired built-in rather than 'isolate at the cooker switch'. Conversation 2 asked genuinely useful questions (fan-only tripping, recent oven-spray cleaning) that pointed at the fan element, and gave the more accurate isolation instruction, but its third reply was a broken fragment ('until then') with no diagnosis or next step, forcing the customer to ask what to do, and even then it never plainly explained the likely fault. Good questions were undermined by poor communication, so Conversation 1 served the homeowner slightly better overall.
